examples.en: Reading in a noisy room requires a lot of concentration.
examples.zh: 在吵鬧的房間裡閱讀需要很高的專注力。

examples.en: The concentration of salt in this water is quite high.
examples.zh: 這個水裡的鹽濃度相當高。

examples.en: Loud music can break your concentration while you study.
examples.zh: 讀書時，大聲的音樂會讓你分心。

examples.en: The teacher explained the concept of fractions with a pizza.
examples.zh: 老師用披薩來說明分數的概念。

examples.en: Time is a difficult concept for young children.
examples.zh: 時間對年幼的孩子來說是個很難懂的概念。

examples.en: The new store is based on a simple concept.
examples.zh: 這家新店是以一個簡單的概念為基礎。

examples.en: I have a question concerning your homework.
examples.zh: 我有一個關於你作業的問題。

examples.en: The school sent a letter concerning the field trip.
examples.zh: 學校寄出一封有關校外教學的信。

examples.en: Please read the notice concerning the new schedule.
examples.zh: 請閱讀關於新時間表的公告。

examples.en: The report showed some concerning results about air quality.
examples.zh: 這份報告顯示了一些令人擔憂的空氣品質結果。

examples.en: His low test scores are concerning to his parents.
examples.zh: 他的低分讓他的父母很擔心。

examples.en: It is concerning that so many students are tired.
examples.zh: 有這麼多學生疲倦，實在令人擔憂。

examples.en: The workers poured concrete to make a new sidewalk.
examples.zh: 工人澆灌混凝土來鋪設新的人行道。

examples.en: The old bridge is made of concrete and steel.
examples.zh: 這座老橋是用混凝土和鋼鐵建成的。

examples.en: Fresh concrete needs time to harden before it can support heavy loads.
examples.zh: 新澆置的混凝土需要時間硬化，才能承受重物。

senses.zh: 具體的；實際的；混凝土製的

examples.en: Please give me a concrete example of your idea.
examples.zh: 請給我一個你想法的具體例子。

examples.en: We need concrete plans before we start the project.
examples.zh: 在開始專案之前，我們需要具體的計畫。

examples.en: The house has a concrete floor in the garage.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的車庫有混凝土地板。

examples.en: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
examples.zh: 指揮舉起雙手，樂團便開始演奏。

examples.en: The train conductor checked every passenger's ticket.
examples.zh: 火車車掌檢查了每位乘客的車票。

examples.en: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
examples.zh: 銅是很好的電導體。

examples.en: Our manager will attend a conference in Tokyo next week.
examples.zh: 我們的經理下週要去東京參加一場研討會。

examples.en: The teacher had a conference with Tom's parents after school.
examples.zh: 老師放學後與湯姆的父母會談。

examples.en: The conference room is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 會議室在三樓。

examples.en: I must confess that I forgot your birthday.
examples.zh: 我必須坦白，我忘了你的生日。

examples.en: The boy confessed that he had broken the window.
examples.zh: 那個男孩承認窗戶是他打破的。

examples.en: She confessed her mistake to the teacher right away.
examples.zh: 她立刻向老師承認了自己的錯誤。

examples.en: She spoke with confidence during the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報時說話很有自信。

examples.en: Passing the exam gave him more confidence.
examples.zh: 通過考試讓他更有信心。

examples.en: The team has full confidence in its new coach.
examples.zh: 這支球隊對新教練充滿信心。

examples.en: There was some confusion about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 大家對開會時間有些困惑。

examples.en: The sudden rain caused confusion at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 突如其來的雨在公車站造成了一片混亂。

examples.en: To avoid confusion, please write your name clearly.
examples.zh: 為了避免混淆，請把你的名字寫清楚。

examples.en: I called my cousin to congratulate her on the new job.
examples.zh: 我打電話恭喜表姐得到新工作。

examples.en: The principal congratulated the students on their success.
examples.zh: 校長祝賀學生們的成功。

examples.en: Let's congratulate the winners with a big round of applause.
examples.zh: 讓我們用熱烈的掌聲向得獎者道賀。

examples.en: Congress passed a new law about school lunches.
examples.zh: 國會通過了一項關於學校午餐的新法律。

examples.en: The members of Congress met to discuss the budget.
examples.zh: 國會議員開會討論預算。

examples.en: Doctors from many countries attended the medical congress.
examples.zh: 來自許多國家的醫師參加了這場醫學大會。

examples.en: The army conquered the small island in the year 1200.
examples.zh: 這支軍隊在一二〇〇年征服了那座小島。

examples.en: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
examples.zh: 她努力克服對公開演講的恐懼。

examples.en: Climbers hope to conquer the highest mountain in the region.
examples.zh: 登山者希望征服這個地區最高的山。

examples.en: He had a guilty conscience after telling a lie.
examples.zh: 他說謊之後良心不安。

examples.en: My conscience told me to return the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 我的良心告訴我要把遺失的皮夾還回去。

examples.en: She has a clear conscience because she did her best.
examples.zh: 她問心無愧，因為她已經盡了全力。

examples.en: Skipping breakfast can have a bad consequence for your health.
examples.zh: 不吃早餐可能對你的健康造成不良後果。

examples.en: As a consequence of the storm, the train was late.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨的緣故，火車誤點了。

examples.en: Whether we go today or tomorrow is of little consequence.
examples.zh: 我們今天或明天去都沒什麼關係。

senses.zh: 隨之而來的；因而發生的

examples.en: The factory closed, and the consequent loss of jobs hurt the town.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉了，隨之而來的失業傷害了這個小鎮。

examples.en: Heavy rain and the consequent flooding closed the road.
examples.zh: 大雨以及隨之而來的淹水讓道路封閉了。

examples.en: The rise in prices and the consequent drop in sales worried the owner.
examples.zh: 物價上漲以及隨之而來的銷量下滑讓老闆很擔心。

senses.zh: 保守的；守舊的；保守估計的

examples.en: My grandfather has a conservative view of fashion.
examples.zh: 我爺爺對時尚抱持保守的看法。

examples.en: The company took a conservative approach to spending money.
examples.zh: 這家公司對花錢採取保守的做法。

examples.en: A conservative estimate says about two hundred people will come.
examples.zh: 保守估計約有兩百人會來。

examples.en: My uncle is a conservative who dislikes quick changes.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個不喜歡快速改變的保守派人士。

examples.en: The conservatives in the group voted against the new plan.
examples.zh: 小組裡的保守派人士投票反對新計畫。

examples.en: She is a conservative when it comes to spending money.
examples.zh: 在花錢這件事上，她是個保守的人。

examples.en: The team consists of ten students from three classes.
examples.zh: 這個團隊由來自三個班級的十名學生組成。

examples.en: A good breakfast consists of eggs, toast and fruit.
examples.zh: 一份好的早餐包含蛋、吐司和水果。

examples.en: The beauty of this town consists in its quiet streets.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的美就在於它安靜的街道。

senses.zh: 一致的；始終如一的；穩定的

examples.en: The coach wants consistent effort from every player.
examples.zh: 教練希望每位球員都能持續不斷地努力。

examples.en: Her story is consistent with what the other students said.
examples.zh: 她的說法與其他學生所說的一致。

examples.en: He has been a consistent student with good grades all year.
examples.zh: 他一整年都是成績穩定的好學生。

examples.en: Girls constitute half of the students in our school.
examples.zh: 女生占了我們學校一半的學生。

examples.en: Twelve months constitute one year in the calendar we use.
examples.zh: 在我們使用的曆法中，十二個月構成一年。

examples.en: Copying another student's answers constitutes cheating, even during a short quiz.
examples.zh: 即使是小考，抄襲其他同學的答案也算作弊。

examples.en: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
examples.zh: 憲法保障所有公民的權利。

examples.en: My grandmother has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick.
examples.zh: 我奶奶體質很好，很少生病。

examples.en: The students studied the constitution of the new club.
examples.zh: 學生們研究了新社團的章程。

examples.en: The city plans to construct a new library near the park.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫在公園附近興建一座新圖書館。

examples.en: Students used paper and glue to construct a model bridge.
examples.zh: 學生們用紙和膠水做出一座橋的模型。

examples.en: He tried to construct a clear sentence in English.
examples.zh: 他試著組成一個清楚的英文句子。

examples.en: Time is a social construct that people agreed on long ago.
examples.zh: 時間是人們很久以前共同接受的一種社會建構。

examples.en: The idea of a perfect student is just a mental construct.
examples.zh: 完美學生的想法只是一種心理上的構想。

examples.en: Teachers discussed how language is a human construct.
examples.zh: 老師們討論了語言如何是一種人為的建構。

examples.en: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
examples.zh: 這座新橋的建造花了兩年。

examples.en: There is a lot of construction on our street this month.
examples.zh: 這個月我們這條街有很多施工。

examples.en: The toy's simple construction makes it easy to repair.
examples.zh: 這個玩具的結構簡單，所以很容易修理。

examples.en: The teacher gave me constructive advice on my essay.
examples.zh: 老師給了我關於作文的建設性建議。

examples.en: We had a constructive meeting and solved the problem.
examples.zh: 我們開了一場有建設性的會議，解決了問題。

examples.en: Constructive criticism helps students improve their work.
examples.zh: 有建設性的批評能幫助學生改進作品。

examples.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its website.
examples.zh: 這家公司聘請了一位顧問來改善網站。

examples.en: My aunt works as a financial consultant at a bank.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在銀行擔任財務顧問。

examples.en: The hospital asked a consultant to review the plan.
examples.zh: 醫院請了一位顧問來審查這份計畫。

examples.en: This old car consumes a lot of gas.
examples.zh: 這輛老車非常耗油。

examples.en: Teenagers often consume too much sugar every week.
examples.zh: 青少年每週攝取的糖分往往過多。

examples.en: Video games consumed most of his free time.
examples.zh: 電玩占去了他大部分的空閒時間。

examples.en: Consumers are buying more products online than before.
examples.zh: 消費者在網路上購買的產品比以前更多。

examples.en: The store lowered its prices to attract consumers.
examples.zh: 這家店降低價格來吸引消費者。

examples.en: A smart consumer compares prices before buying.
examples.zh: 聰明的消費者在購買前會比較價格。

examples.en: Please put the leftover soup in a plastic container.
examples.zh: 請把剩下的湯裝進塑膠容器裡。

examples.en: The ship carried hundreds of containers across the ocean.
examples.zh: 這艘船載著數百個貨櫃橫越海洋。

examples.en: Keep the rice in a container with a tight lid.
examples.zh: 把米放在有緊密蓋子的容器裡。

examples.en: The content of the speech was easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這場演講的內容很容易理解。

examples.en: This drink has a low sugar content.
examples.zh: 這種飲料的含糖量很低。

examples.en: Many websites offer free video content for students learning English.
examples.zh: 許多網站提供免費的影片內容，供學英文的學生使用。

examples.en: The cat looked content as it slept in the sun.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在陽光下睡覺，看起來很滿足。

examples.en: He is content with a simple life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他對鄉下簡單的生活感到滿足。

examples.en: She was content to wait for the next bus.
examples.zh: 她願意安心等下一班公車。

examples.en: Our class won the singing contest last Friday.
examples.zh: 我們班在上週五的歌唱比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She entered a writing contest at the library.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了圖書館的寫作比賽。

examples.en: The contest is open to all students in the school.
examples.zh: 這場比賽開放給學校所有學生參加。

examples.en: Three teams will contest the championship this weekend.
examples.zh: 三支隊伍本週末將爭奪冠軍。

examples.en: The company decided to contest the decision in court.
examples.zh: 公司決定向法院對這項決定提出異議。

examples.en: Students may contest their grades if they find a mistake.
examples.zh: 如果學生發現錯誤，可以對成績提出異議。

examples.en: You can guess the meaning of a new word from its context.
examples.zh: 你可以從上下文猜出新單字的意思。

examples.en: The teacher explained the historical context of the poem.
examples.zh: 老師說明了這首詩的歷史背景。

examples.en: His joke sounded rude when taken out of context.
examples.zh: 他的玩笑被斷章取義後聽起來很無禮。

senses.zh: 接二連三的；頻繁的；不斷重複的

examples.en: The continual noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上不斷傳來的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: Continual phone calls interrupted our dinner, so we turned off the phone.
examples.zh: 接二連三的電話打斷了我們的晚餐，因此我們關掉了電話。

examples.en: Her continual questions made the teacher smile.
examples.zh: 她一再提出的問題讓老師笑了。

examples.en: There was a continuous line of cars on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的車輛連成一條長龍。

examples.en: The machine needs a continuous supply of water.
examples.zh: 這台機器需要持續不斷的水供應。

examples.en: We heard continuous rain throughout the night.
examples.zh: 我們整夜都聽見持續不斷的雨聲。

examples.en: The two students had contrary opinions about the plan.
examples.zh: 這兩位學生對這個計畫的意見相反。

examples.en: The wind blew in a direction contrary to the boat's path.
examples.zh: 風吹的方向與船的航道相反。

examples.en: Contrary ideas made the discussion more interesting.
examples.zh: 相互對立的想法讓討論變得更有趣。

examples.en: I thought the test would be hard, but the contrary was true.
examples.zh: 我以為考試會很難，結果正好相反。

examples.en: On the contrary, I enjoyed the long trip.
examples.zh: 正好相反，我很喜歡這趟長途旅行。

examples.en: Unless you hear the contrary, meet us at six.
examples.zh: 除非你聽到相反的消息，否則請六點和我們碰面。

examples.en: There is a clear contrast between the two brothers.
examples.zh: 這兩兄弟之間有明顯的差異。

examples.en: The black-and-white photo shows a strong contrast between light and shadow.
examples.zh: 這張黑白照片呈現出光影之間強烈的對比。

examples.en: In contrast to his sister, Ben loves to cook.
examples.zh: 與他姊姊相反，班很愛下廚。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to contrast city life with country life.
examples.zh: 老師要我們對照都市生活與鄉村生活。

examples.en: Her bright coat contrasts with the gray sky.
examples.zh: 她鮮豔的外套與灰色的天空形成對比。

examples.en: The report contrasts the prices of the two stores.
examples.zh: 這份報告比較了兩家商店的價格。

examples.en: Every student contributed ten dollars to the class party.
examples.zh: 每位學生都捐了十元給班上的派對。

examples.en: Regular exercise contributes to good health by keeping our bodies active.
examples.zh: 規律運動讓身體保持活躍，有助於身體健康。

examples.en: She contributes an article to the school newspaper each month.
examples.zh: 她每個月都為校刊投稿一篇文章。

examples.en: Everyone made a contribution to the success of the event.
examples.zh: 每個人都為活動的成功作出了貢獻。

examples.en: The school welcomes your contribution to the book fund.
examples.zh: 學校歡迎你捐款給圖書基金。

examples.en: Her contribution to the magazine was a short story.
examples.zh: 她投給雜誌的稿件是一篇短篇故事。

examples.en: Online shopping offers great convenience for busy people.
examples.zh: 網路購物為忙碌的人提供了很大的便利。

examples.en: For your convenience, the store opens at seven.
examples.zh: 為了方便您，這家店七點就開門。

examples.en: The hotel has every modern convenience, including free Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 這間旅館有各種現代化的便利設施，包括免費無線網路。

examples.en: The comic book convention attracts thousands of fans each year.
examples.zh: 漫畫大會每年吸引數千名粉絲。

examples.en: It is a social convention to say thank you.
examples.zh: 說謝謝是一種社會慣例。

examples.en: Many countries signed the convention to protect the ocean.
examples.zh: 許多國家簽署了保護海洋的公約。

examples.en: My parents prefer a conventional wedding in a church.
examples.zh: 我父母偏好在教堂舉行傳統的婚禮。

examples.en: The restaurant serves conventional dishes with a modern twist.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應傳統菜色，並加入現代的變化。

examples.en: She chose a conventional career as a teacher.
examples.zh: 她選擇了教師這個傳統的職業。

examples.en: The two students conversed quietly in the library.
examples.zh: 那兩位學生在圖書館裡輕聲交談。

examples.en: I enjoy conversing with tourists in English.
examples.zh: 我喜歡用英文和觀光客交談。

examples.en: The guests conversed for hours after dinner.
examples.zh: 客人們在晚餐後交談了好幾個小時。

examples.en: A smile can convey a friendly message without any words.
examples.zh: 微笑不用言語就能傳達友善的訊息。

examples.en: Please convey my thanks to your parents.
examples.zh: 請代我向你的父母轉達謝意。

examples.en: A long belt conveys the boxes to the truck.
examples.zh: 一條長長的輸送帶把箱子運到卡車上。

examples.en: I could not convince my brother to join the club.
examples.zh: 我沒辦法說服我弟弟加入社團。

examples.en: The salesperson convinced us to buy the larger size.
examples.zh: 店員說服我們買比較大的尺寸。

examples.en: Her clear answer convinced the teacher that she was right.
examples.zh: 她清楚的回答讓老師確信她是對的。

examples.en: Students must cooperate to finish the group project.
examples.zh: 學生們必須合作才能完成小組專題。

examples.en: The two companies agreed to cooperate on a new product.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司同意合作開發新產品。

examples.en: Please cooperate with the staff during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 消防演習時請配合工作人員。

examples.en: The project succeeded because of everyone's cooperation.
examples.zh: 這個專案能成功是因為大家的合作。

examples.en: Thank you for your cooperation during the check-in.
examples.zh: 感謝您在報到時的配合。

examples.en: Close cooperation between teachers and parents helps children learn.
examples.zh: 老師與家長的密切合作有助於孩子學習。

examples.en: The children were cooperative and cleaned the room quickly.
examples.zh: 孩子們很願意配合，很快就把房間打掃乾淨。

examples.en: We need a cooperative team to win this game.
examples.zh: 我們需要一支願意合作的團隊才能贏得這場比賽。

examples.en: The manager thanked the cooperative staff for working late.
examples.zh: 經理感謝樂意配合、加班到很晚的員工。

examples.en: My uncle sells fruit through a farmers' cooperative.
examples.zh: 我叔叔透過農民合作社銷售水果。

examples.en: The cooperative buys rice from local farmers.
examples.zh: 這家合作社向當地農民收購稻米。

examples.en: She joined a food cooperative to save money.
examples.zh: 她加入了一個食品合作社來省錢。

examples.en: It is hard to cope with so much homework.
examples.zh: 要應付這麼多功課很困難。

examples.en: She learned to cope with stress by taking a walk.
examples.zh: 她學會用散步來因應壓力。

examples.en: The small shop could not cope with the crowd.
examples.zh: 這家小店應付不了那麼多人潮。

examples.en: Copper is often used to make electrical wires.
examples.zh: 銅常被用來製作電線。

examples.en: The old pot was made of copper.
examples.zh: 這個舊鍋子是用銅做的。

examples.en: He found a few old coppers in the bottom drawer.
examples.zh: 他在最底下的抽屜裡找到幾枚舊銅幣。

examples.en: She wore a copper bracelet on her left arm.
examples.zh: 她的左手臂戴著一只銅手環。

examples.en: The kitchen has a set of copper pans.
examples.zh: 這間廚房有一組銅製平底鍋。

examples.en: The leaves turned a copper color in autumn.
examples.zh: 樹葉在秋天變成了銅色。

examples.en: Please plug the cord into the wall socket.
examples.zh: 請把電線插進牆上的插座。

examples.en: He tied the box with a strong cord.
examples.zh: 他用一條堅韌的細繩把箱子綁起來。

examples.en: Don't pull the phone charger by its cord.
examples.zh: 不要拉著充電線來拔手機充電器。

examples.en: Your answer does not correspond with the one in the book.
examples.zh: 你的答案與書上的答案不相符。

examples.en: She corresponds with a pen pal in Canada.
examples.zh: 她和一位加拿大的筆友通信。

examples.en: The numbers on the map correspond to the places in the list.
examples.zh: 地圖上的數字對應清單上的地點。

examples.en: She wore a witch costume to the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 她穿著女巫裝去參加萬聖節派對。

examples.en: The actors changed into their costumes before the show.
examples.zh: 演員們在演出前換上了戲服。

examples.en: The museum has a display of traditional costumes.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展示著傳統服飾。
